title: Elderly Man and Robot Companion
description: An elderly man in a green suit and hat walks with a cane along a cracked black road, carrying a small blue robot on his back. The scene features a surreal landscape with purple fields, a red sky with geometric patterns, distant mountains, and various symbolic elements like skulls and warning signs.
prompt: An elderly man with a green suit, green hat, and cane walks along a cracked black asphalt road while carrying a small blue retro robot with red accents on his back. The robot has an antenna and appears to be projecting light. They are surrounded by fields of glowing purple flowers under a dramatic red and black sky filled with geometric shapes, concentric circles, a black pyramid, and floating orbs. In the distance are jagged black mountains. The ground shows white cracks and various symbolic icons including skulls, warning triangles with figures, and small dog-like creatures. Dark surreal atmosphere with strong contrast and illustrative linework.
